// What a C++ user of package k sees: its exported constants, constants of C++.
#include "gpkg/example.com/consts/k/pkg.hpp"

namespace k = gpkg_example_dcom__consts__k;

static_assert(k::Small == 1e-300);
static_assert(k::Pi2 > 6.28 && k::Pi2 < 6.29);
static_assert(k::F32 == 0.1f);
static_assert(k::U8 == 200 && k::Neg == -128);
static_assert(k::Ch == 'x');
static_assert(k::Flag);
static_assert(k::Sh == 4);
static_assert(k::Str.size() == 25 && k::Str[20] == '\0');
static_assert(k::Unicode.size() == 14);
static_assert(std::is_same_v<decltype(k::U8), const uint8_t>);
static_assert(std::is_same_v<decltype(k::Str), const std::string_view>);
